title: The Lord's money is his tested words
english: The money of the Lord is the words of the Lord—silver tested by fire. If I teach badly, my money is rejected; if I teach well, it is a just interest. I want mercy rather than sacrifice.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 12 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via Archive PDF pdftotext; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Trigg FOTC / Prinzivalli SC / Perrone 2015.
After tip f8d17b8f; Psalms Rufinus Homilia IV in Ps 36 CLOSEOUT.
orientation: Origen is explaining that the words of the Lord are the Lord's money, tested silver, and that a teacher's teaching is either approved or rejected money.

title: Blessing and cursing decide inheritance of the land
english: Those who bless him will inherit the land; those who curse him will be destroyed (Psalm 37:22, LXX 36:22). Glory to Christ. Amen.
